title: Nee Aatmatho – Vijay Kondapuram Telugu Christian Lyrics

english: Nee premanu choopinchayya, nee swaramu vinipinchayya
Nee sannidhiloki nanu cherchayya, parishuddhaatmanu kummarinchayya
Karuninchu devaa krupa choopumayya, naa thodu neevai nadipinchu Yesayya
Naa doshamulanu oppukontini, nee daya koraku thapinchithini
Nee prema viluva thelusukontini, thirigi nee vaipu tharalithini

Naa vaipu parugethhi kaugililo nanu cherchi
Nee premanu choopinchithivi, nee vaatsalyamu dayachesithivi

translation: Chorus:
Lead me with Your Spirit, O Lord,
Show me Your path, O Lord.
Instill Your truth within me,
Fulfill Your will in my life.
Show me Your love, let me hear Your voice,
Bring me into Your presence, pour out Your Holy Spirit!
Have mercy, O God, show Your grace; be my companion and guide me, Jesus!
Verse 1:
I pushed away Your presence and ran away,
I surrendered and fell to worldly desires.
Seeking temporary pleasures,
I left You and lost myself.
I confessed my transgressions, I longed for Your mercy;
Realizing the value of Your love, I turned back to You.
Have mercy, O God, show Your grace; be my companion and guide me, Jesus!
Verse 2:
My Father God, my Shepherd,
You transformed me with Your love!
Noticing my plight, You showed mercy;
You ran toward me and gathered me into Your arms.
You demonstrated Your love and granted Your tenderness;
You upheld me with Your hand and welcomed me into Your eternal kingdom.
I will live for You alone, Lord; I will proclaim Your love, Jesus!

credits.Vocals: Allen Ganta & Enosh Kumar & Jerusha Joseph & Vijay Kondapuram

intro: Nee Aatmatho is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Vijay Kondapuram, sung by Allen Ganta, Enosh Kumar, Jerusha Joseph, Vijay Kondapuram and music composed by John Sathwick. This song was released on July 10, 2026, through Vijay Kondapuram – Telugu and Vijay Kondapuram – Hindi YouTube channels.
